title: Mushroom omelette

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Mushroom omelette is a Mistlands-tier food.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
Mushroom omelette is produced in a level 5 Cauldron with:
• 3 Egg
• 3 Jotun puffs

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Mushroom omelette is more time and resource-intensive than Salad to produce, but provides more health and stamina.
• While the mushroom omelette provides slightly lower bonuses than Fish 'n' bread, the process of catching Anglerfish is relatively tedious and time-consuming.
